fact: Chapter 10 is titled 'Set For A Mental Revolution' and opens by asking whether you are set for a mental revolution
Supernatural mentality or mental excellence for mental exploits is impossible and cannot be operated without the ministry of the Holy Spirit, who reveals and co-ordinates its operation inside you
1 Corinthians 2:6-13 is quoted at length, including 'Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him'
The passage says God hath revealed them unto us by his Spirit, for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of God

The Holy Spirit sits upon your mentality to bring everything around you that will help you get to where you are going: He collates facts for you and delivers them in concrete terms, so you have no doubt why you are taking the step He tells you to take
The Holy Spirit was at work in Joseph, Daniel, Peter and Stephen
It is one thing to know that the Holy Spirit is available, and another to know how to gain access into His ministry
The kind of intelligence in view is the one that will make you become master over the Chaldeans, magicians and astrologers, standing clearly above them in results
Ephesians 3:10 talks about the manifold wisdom of God that disarms principalities and powers, putting them in subjection, with you standing and walking in total command over them
There is no substitute for the ministry of the Holy Spirit in the school of divine wisdom or supernatural mentality
In John 14:26 Jesus said the Holy Spirit will teach us all things, and in John 16:13 He said the same Holy Spirit will show us things to come
The Holy Spirit becomes your medium of connection to supernatural intelligence, bringing to light the things that are hid inside God
Colossians 2:3 is cited, that in Christ are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge needed to give you your place and make you fulfil your dreams in life
The Holy Spirit is your principal access into that great treasure of wisdom and knowledge, which gives you insight, foresight, dominion and unequaled creativity, cited as Job 28:7-28
Numbers 27:18 tells us that Moses laid his hands on Joshua and he was filled with the spirit of wisdom
The Holy Spirit is the instrument of access and the gateway to the realms of divine intelligence, and you have to embrace His ministry before you can operate in that realm
The Spirit of God is essentially the spirit of wisdom, and in Acts 6:10 they could not resist the spirit and wisdom with which Stephen spoke
The local fisherman Peter suddenly became a super intelligent man by the ministry of this mental catalyst called the Holy Spirit, who revealed a new Peter to the world
Without opening any book Peter blasted the whole city with an irresistible message of redemption, and 3,000 souls got saved the same hour
Peter's was an impromptu delivery, unprepared for, yet so profound, and the reader is told to check the substance and arrangement of the details
The Holy Spirit is called the Excellent Spirit in Daniel chapter 6, and His nature is a pointer to His mission, which is to supernaturally generate excellence in the believer
He introduces supernatural order to your mental faculty so you are able to coordinate things that are naturally beyond the level of your intellectual capacity
If you yield to the Holy Spirit you will go beyond speaking in tongues and laying hands on the sick, to a place of astounding mental exploits
The Holy Spirit has a mission of mental revolution in your life, so give Him the place and He will naturally unfold things you need to know
The section is titled 'Remaining Relevant': you need a higher dimension of supernatural mental empowerment, made possible by a fresh release of the Holy Ghost, to remain relevant tomorrow
Where you are now is not good enough for tomorrow; today is just good enough for today, and you must prepare today for what will be enough for tomorrow
You must be constantly filled afresh in order to remain relevant to your generation
One day in Benin, Archbishop Benson Idahosa and the author were riding in a car together when he pointed out a building that used to be the best in Benin many years ago
That building was a bungalow with a balcony in front, and its owner was living in London when he built it
The owner would come home in December and stand on the balcony waving to everyone that passed by, and everybody would marvel 'Ah! What a house!'
By the time the Archbishop told the story the house was such that if the government were to reconstruct the road they would not think twice about pulling it down: it had lost relevance
It is not possible by might or power; it has to be by the enabling of the Spirit of God
When it comes and rests on your mentality you become a man of sweatless triumph and dignity among men
Chapter 11 is titled 'Now You Know...' and states that you possess a unique mind, a redeemed, regenerated and anointed mind, the mind of Christ
It is a sound mind and has what it takes to produce sound results and amazing mental exploits
God is preparing you to be relevant in this new millennium because Jesus is getting ready to return, and the Church is taking her place at the top
From now on your generation will start searching for where you live, and you will become a mighty blessing to your generation
It is now up to individuals to begin to take their places, and your place will not be lost to another
The brains that will humble the intellectual world by reason of their supernatural dimension, and leave an indelible mark on this new millennium, are being birthed right now, and you are one of them
God is fulfilling Psalm 87 in our midst: all the springs of life are in Zion
By your encounter with the teaching in this book God is out to stamp something on your head that will mark you out the remaining days of your life
The wind is blowing and the giants of this new millennium are rising, and out of the once-upon-a-time valley of dry bones a mighty host is rising to their feet

The closing prophecies are that the wind of God infuse fresh life into whatever appears dead, that the fire of the Holy Ghost go through your mental faculty and burn off every chaff, and that there be a supernatural refining of your mental system
One striking supernatural insight is worth more in value than a lifetime of struggles
One striking supernatural insight on your job, business and family is all you need to succeed in life
Once upon a time the gathering in their all-night meetings was just about fifteen people, but after just one insight the author got, the next meeting had 3,000 gathered

One striking supernatural insight is enough to bring a man into the limelight, more than enough to release a man from the prison and plant him in the palace, to set a colourful order back in your destiny, and to make a millionaire of any pauper
